# T14: original OmniIsaacGymEnvs AnymalTerrain

Full upstream environment in `checkout/`, unmodified, version `f8f91bcf73cfd8ede2eab70e19dd70162abf9775`. Source https://github.com/isaac-sim/OmniIsaacGymEnvs; the upstream licence is retained. `docker/` Native IsaacSim4.0.0 Independent Mirror, `assets/` Official 4.0 ANYmal Original USD and mesh depend on, `prepare_assets.py` downloads and validates closed packages, `asset-manifest.json` fixes hash. The dynamic terrain is generated by the original code and does not require a separate scene. Fit to `environment/benchmarks/omniisaacgymenvs/project.py`.

Tool sending 12 dimensional joint offset vector, target = default angle +. 5* action; Native PD gains are 80/2 with ±80 Nm torque limits. No gait policy is supplied. There is no limited action clip, the tool only validates the limited value and does not impersonate [-1, 1] as an original interface. The original 188 dimension noise observation (including height measurements) was retained, only policy obs for models, states/reward/internal extra for models. Failed/reward/drive unchanged, binary success=null. The external subcategory only prevents automatic reset after the end-state and retains the end-state evaluation and video.

** time-series details **: The original configuration is decimation4, physics. 005 calculated 1000 step/20 s, 750 step/15 s perturbation; The original VecEnv also steps once after the four ticks in pre_physics_step. Fit to keep the call, without repairing the task, expected to be measured dt=.025s and simulate time difference per step assert. The original reset entrance carries out its own zero action, and this time warmup will be properly recorded in native_reset_progress_steps, not model action. No physical 20 s can be declared verified.

## Separate Isaac Sim 6.0.1 Experiment Configuration

The default is still the original Isaac Sim 4.0.0. `--runtime-profile isaac6` only overwrite running time, use
`world/omniisaacgymenvs:isaac6.0.1-experimental`, which is not the official run-time accomplishment.
benchmark checkout, original asset, task configuration and original reward/termination remain unchanged.

Sim 6 removed `omni.isaac.gym`; Extract the full original extension from the official 4.0 mirror that you have licensed:

```bash
python third_party/benchmarks/omniisaacgymenvs/compat/extract_gym.py
python scripts/eval/native_projects.py build --project omniisaacgymenvs --runtime-profile isaac6
python third_party/benchmarks/omniisaacgymenvs/docker/run.py --runtime-profile isaac6 --task T14 --mode probe --steps 4 --output var/runs/docker/native17/t14-isaac6-probe
```

Original extension file-by-file verification saved at `compat/vendor-provenance.json` and the original licence retained.
Its vendor directory is only locally used and not in open source packages; Ripping does not require the start of an old version of GPU.
External namespace adaptation is `environment/benchmarks/omniisaacgymenvs/project_isaac6.py`.
The original `VecEnvRLGames.step` and task code are called directly, preserving four internal physics steps and one additional wrapper step,
0.025 s at each step of the real control cycle; as well as the original reward's 0.02 s scaling and 1,000-step limit.
Videos are collected by independent zero-time rendering, not as additional policy observations. The original mission did not have a light, so the independent review of DomeLight has a non-physical prim persistence; Opens only during the collection of videos, setting finally as invisible and intensity=0. Every frame check the light is hidden and the simulation clock remains unchanged. The light is hidden during the execution of the original action, and the original 188-dimensional observations do not include a review of the light.

The current test results are based on `World/docs/native17/VALIDATION.md` and the operational `exit.json`/ `result.json`;
Building success does not mean simulation or mission success.
